sections.content_text: Section 336 - Certain Errors not to Vitiate Assessment etc. Any assessment, order, notice, warrant or other instrument made, issued or executed or deemed to be made, issued or executed under this Act, merely for want of any prescribed form nor shall it be void or otherwise invalid by reason of any mistake, error or deviation therein unless such lack of form, mistake, error or deviation actually prejudices the taxpayer.
